nurse.text: Alright, my lover! Exeter Sanctuary. Let's have a look at your lot. Been walking the moor, have they? There's heather in that one's ear.
What can we do for you?

then.text: On the counter they go. A nice rest, and I'll put the kettle on.
There we are, good as new. Proper job.
The Ark's by the window. Lovely view of the cathedral, if you lean.

else.text: Off you go, my bird. Mind the cobbles in the Close, they've had worse than you on them.
